turns.message: On 23rd November 2021 we ordered 30 mosquito and bird nets from Amazon and paid Rs. 17,970 in advance with a Bajaj EMI card. Only one of the 30 items arrived. We cancelled the whole order through Amazon on 29th November 2021 and returned the one item, as Amazon instructed, on 8th December 2021. We sent notices to Amazon and to the seller, Shiv Enterprises, but no refund has come. Meanwhile three EMIs have already been deducted from my bank account.

expected.rationale: Refund not received, exact cancellation date, notices sent to the platform and seller (contact made), grievance officer not mentioned.
